nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. The zero ideal of $A$ is a Poisson ideal.
nodes.title: The zero ideal is a Poisson ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket $\lbrace \cdot, \cdot \rbrace$. For every $a \in A$, $\lbrace a, 0 \rbrace = 0$.
nodes.title: Bracket with zero

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket $\lbrace \cdot, \cdot \rbrace$. An ideal $P$ of $A$ is a Poisson ideal when $\lbrace a, p \rbrace \in P$ for all $a \in A$ and all $p \in P$.
nodes.title: Poisson ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. An ideal $P$ of $A$ is a Poisson prime when it is both a prime ideal and a Poisson ideal.
nodes.title: Poisson prime ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket, and let $J$ and $P$ be ideals of $A$. If $P \subseteq J$ and $P$ is a Poisson ideal, then $P$ is contained in the Poisson core of $J$.
nodes.title: Poisson ideals inside an ideal lie in its Poisson core

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra. A Poisson bracket on $A$ is a map assigning to $x, y \in A$ an element $\lbrace x, y \rbrace \in A$ such that for all $x, y, z \in A$ and $c \in \mathbb{C}$: $\lbrace x + y, z \rbrace = \lbrace x, z \rbrace + \lbrace y, z \rbrace$ and $\lbrace x, y + z \rbrace = \lbrace x, y \rbrace + \lbrace x, z \rbrace$; $\lbrace x, y \rbrace = -\lbrace y, x \rbrace$; the Leibniz…
nodes.title: Poisson bracket

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. For every ideal $J$ of $A$, the Poisson core of $J$ is the greatest element of the set of Poisson ideals of $A$ contained in $J$: it is a Poisson ideal contained in $J$, and it contains every Poisson ideal of $A$ contained in $J$.
nodes.title: Universal property of the Poisson core

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. For every ideal $J$ of $A$, the Poisson core of $J$ is contained in $J$.
nodes.title: The Poisson core is contained in the ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. For every ideal $J$ of $A$, the Poisson core of $J$ is a Poisson ideal.
nodes.title: The Poisson core is a Poisson ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket. For an ideal $J$ of $A$, the Poisson core of $J$ is the supremum, in the lattice of ideals of $A$, of the set of all Poisson ideals of $A$ contained in $J$.
nodes.title: Poisson core

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative $\mathbb{C}$-algebra with a Poisson bracket, and let $I$, $K$ and $J$ be ideals of $A$. If $I$ and $K$ are Poisson ideals contained in $J$, then their sum $I + K$ is a Poisson ideal contained in $J$.
nodes.title: The sum of two Poisson ideals inside an ideal

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
